documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Management stated that ABS Marine reported robust financial performance for FY26 with significant growth in revenue, EBITDA, and profit after tax, driven by owned fleet expansion and disciplined execution. The company inducted the offshore support vessel Artemis during H2 FY26 and is scheduled to take delivery of another offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27. Looking ahead, the management remains optimistic about offshore and maritime sector opportunities and expects a top-line increase of around 10% in the current financial year assuming vessels run in the second half. ABS Marine Services Limited reported its financial performance for the half year and year ended March 31, 2026, highlighting growth in consolidated total income to ₹322.64 Cr and net profit to ₹80.80 Cr. Management noted that performance was supported by momentum in core operations, expansion of the owned fleet, improved utilization levels, and disciplined cost management.

guidance.claim: Management expects a top-line increase of about 10% in the current financial year assuming all vessels run in the second half.
guidance.quote: As regards the guidance on the top line is concerned, we can expect a 10% increase -- assuming that all the vessels will be running in the second half. We can expect on the turnover front a 10% increase from the current levels.

guidance.claim: Management expects the EBITDA margin band of 45% to 50% to continue.
guidance.quote: As regards the EBITDA is concerned, I am sure that currently it is in the band of 45 to 50. I am sure that that will continue.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market continue to improve utilization levels and charter rates.
demand_outlook.quote: Additionally, favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market, supported by an aging global fleet and limited new vessel additions, continue to improve utilization levels and charter rates across segments.

demand_outlook.claim: Management mentioned that ONGC is anticipated to release a tender for about 20 vessels.
demand_outlook.quote: See, demand is as of -- as we talk now, ONGC is asking for about 20-vessel tender is going to come.

capex_expansion.claim: During H2 FY26, the company successfully inducted the offshore support vessel Artemis into its owned fleet.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of this strategy, during H2 FY26, we successfully inducted the offshore support vessel, Artemis, into our owned fleet, expanding our vessel ownership portfolio and improving our ability to participate in higher-value offshore projects.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Further enhancing our offshore capabilities, we are also scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The cost of acquisition for both new vessels totaled about $15 million.
capex_expansion.quote: Just a moment. We have totally, we have spent about $15 million for both the vessels.

margins_costs.claim: Total income for FY26 stood at INR322.64 crores, registering a year-on-year growth of 75.05%.
margins_costs.quote: On a consolidated basis, total income stood at INR322.64 crores, registering a robust growth of 75.05% year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA increased by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores, with the EBITDA margin expanding by 1,763 basis points to 47.28% in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased significantly by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores, while the EBITDA margin expanded sharply by 1,763 basis points to 47.28%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for FY26 rose by 196.45% to INR80.80 crores, with the PAT margin improving by 1,026 basis points to 25.04%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax rose by 196.45% to INR80.80 crores, with a PAT margin improving by 1,026 basis points to 25.04%.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that improved utilization levels, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management contributed to healthy growth in revenue and profitability.
margins_costs.quote: Improved utilization levels, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management have contributed to healthy growth in both revenue and profitability.

orders_capacity.claim: Out of eight owned vessels, five are on long-term charter.
orders_capacity.quote: Out of the eight vessels that we own, five of them are on long-term charter, three of them -- two of them have just come out of charter, and third one is just we have acquired, so it has to go into the dry dock and then only come out and then only we put her in the market.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates a total of 12 vessels, including four smaller vessels on long-term charters running in Chennai Port and Ennore Port.
orders_capacity.quote: No, 12 number is correct. The other four vessels are smaller vessels, they are on long-term charter. They are pilot boat and security boat. Four of them, two of them running in Chennai Port and two of them are running in Ennore Port. So, totally we have a, you know, 12 vessels.

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking statements are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties, and assumptions that are difficult to predict.
risks_headwinds.quote: Such forward-looking statements are not guarantee of future performance and are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to expand fleet size by adding seven to eight vessels over a period of two to three years.
management_commitments.quote: I think Captain has already told that the vision is to expand and to go forward for seven to eight vessels over a period of two to three years.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated a continued commitment to building a robust asset base that drives operational efficiency, enhances service delivery, and supports sustainable long-term growth.
management_commitments.quote: We stay committed to building a robust asset base that drives operational efficiency, enhances service delivery, and supports sustainable long-term growth.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
